sql.ahj.permit.detail: SELECT p.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 1 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS submissionContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 6 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS followUpContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 7 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS printLocations, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(notes))) FROM ( SELECT n.id, n.note, n.date_created, n.date_modified, n.created_by_id AS "createdById", created_by.first_name || ' ' || created_by.last_name AS "createdBy", n.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", modified_by.first_name || ' ' || modified_by.last_name AS "modifiedBy" FROM brs.ahj_note n INNER JOIN flow."user" created_by ON n.created_by_id = created_by.id INNER JOIN flow."user" modified_by ON n.modified_by_id = modified_by.id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_note apn ON n.id = apn.ahj_note_id WHERE apn.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND n.archived IS FALSE AND n.note_type_id = 1 ) AS notes), '[]' ) AS notes, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 1 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS submissionChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 2 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS revisionChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 3 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS asBuiltChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 4 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS submissionLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 5 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS followUpLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.first_name AS "firstName", u.last_name AS "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "fullName", o.org_name AS "office", o.id AS "officeId" FROM flow."user" u INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id AND ((now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date) BETWEEN up.start_date::date AND coalesce(up.end_date::date, (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date) INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = up.org_id LEFT JOIN brs.org_metro_area oma ON oma.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN brs.ahj ON ahj.metro_area_id = oma.metro_area_id WHERE o.org_type_id = 8 AND ahj.id = p.ahj_id) fots ), '[]' ) AS servicingFots FROM brs.ahj_permit p WHERE p.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.permit.createBlank: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit (ahj_id, deposit_amount, average_permit_fee, engineering_letter_required, print_location, stamped_plan, archived, date_created, created_by_id, business_license_expiration_date, contractor_license_expiration_date, business_license, contractor_license) VALUES (:ahjId, null, null, null, null, null, false, now(), :currentUser, null, null, null, null) RETURNING id
sql.ahj.permit.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit (ahj_id, deposit_amount, average_permit_fee, engineering_letter_required, print_location, stamped_plan, date_created, created_by_id, business_license, contractor_license, business_license_expiration_date, contractor_license_expiration_date) VALUES (:ahjId, :depositAmount, :averagePermitFee, :engineeringLetterRequired, :printLocation, :stampedPlan, now(), :currentUser, :businessLicense, :contractorLicense, :businessLicenseExpirationDate, :contractorLicenseExpirationDate)
sql.ahj.permit.update:
UPDATE brs.ahj_permit SET ahj_id = :ahjId, deposit_amount = :depositAmount, average_permit_fee = :averagePermitFee, engineering_letter_required = :engineeringLetterRequired, print_location = :printLocation, stamped_plan = :stampedPlan, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser, business_license = :businessLicense, contractor_license = :contractorLicense, business_license_expiration_date = :businessLicenseExpirationDate, contractor_license_expiration_date = :contractorLicenseExpirationDate, other_license = :otherLicense, other_license_expiration_date = :otherLicenseExpirationDate, revision_fee_amount = :revisionFeeAmount, as_built_fee_amount = :asBuiltFeeAmount, follow_up_fee_amount = :followUpFeeAmount, delivery_fee_amount = :deliveryFeeAmount, approval_timeline = :approvalTimeline, documents_available = :documentsAvailable,
submission_note = :submissionNote, revision_note = :revisionNote, as_built_note = :asBuiltNote, delivery_note = :deliveryNote WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.link.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit_link (ahj_permit_id, name, link, username, password, notes, date_created, created_by_id, link_type_id) VALUES (:ahjPermitId, :name, :link, :username, :password, :notes, now(), :currentUser, :linkTypeId)
sql.ahj.permit.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET ahj_permit_id = :ahjPermitId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
